import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a sample dataset
data = {
    "amount": [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    "is_fraud": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    "transaction_type": ["refund", "payment", "transfer", "payment", "payment"],
    "hour_of_day": [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Plot a bar chart to show the distribution of transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x="transaction_type", data=df)
plt.title("Distribution of Transaction Types")
plt.xlabel("Transaction Type")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.savefig("output.png")
plt.show()

# Plot a histogram to show the distribution of transaction amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(df["amount"], bins=10)
plt.title("Distribution of Transaction Amounts")
plt.xlabel("Amount")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.savefig("output.png")
plt.show()

# Plot a bar chart to show the distribution of transactions by hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x="hour_of_day", data=df)
plt.title("Distribution of Transactions by Hour of Day")
plt.xlabel("Hour of Day")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.savefig("output.png")
plt.show()
